releases.notes:
EMUtils 1.0.0: a redesigned settings UI, a minimap and world map, a waypoint overhaul, config profiles and a batch of new HUD features. This release supports **26.2** and **26.3**. Your settings, keybinds and data from 0.14.0 carry over.

## Added

- **New settings UI**: a card layout with a clean font, a description for every setting, each feature's settings in its own sheet, search, Open buttons and needs-another-mod badges. It replaces the classic screens.
  - Menu settings: theme, accent color, fonts, text size, motion and more.
  - Remember last menu position: reopens the menu on the category, scroll position and settings sheet you left it on.
  - The Pack Manager, Script Manager and editor, Screenshot Gallery, Mass Drop list, Command Shortcuts, Spotify players and HUD Layout Editor all use the new look.
  - EMUtils shows as a small icon in the pause menu and title screen icon row.
- **Minimap**: drawn with real block textures, biome colors, water depth and height shading with a slight 3D look. Square or round, turning with you or north-up, with zoom keys, your waypoints and coordinates.
- **World Map**: saved exploration, an animation from the minimap, waypoints, image export and a teleport command.
  - Cave view, Nether roof and void island handling, and an Entity Radar on both maps.
  - In singleplayer, the map fills in from the world's files, underground layers included.
  - A Loading Speed setting, and much faster loading of big worlds.
  - Everything is set up in one Map screen, opened from a single Map card.
  - Servers that restrict Xaero's Minimap and World Map or JourneyMap restrict EMUtils' maps the same way, with a chat line saying what the server turned off.
- **Waypoints overhaul**:
  - Colored markers that shrink and fade with distance and pin to the screen edge, with a font choice and a label background.
  - Edit name, position, color and beacon. Search, sort, and sets as collapsible groups. Waypoints from other dimensions show in the list and the world, with Overworld/Nether coordinate conversion.
  - Share waypoints in chat, add one at the crosshair, and get an offer (or auto-add) for coordinates and Xaero or JourneyMap waypoints sent in chat.
  - Keeps the last few deaths, and removes a death waypoint when you get back to it.
  - Import from Xaero's Minimap brings its waypoints over for every world and server at once. Your own waypoints are no longer limited to 64 per world.
  - Add Waypoint while holding an explorer map fills in where it leads, and Show Explorer Map Destinations shows it as a temporary waypoint.
  - EMUtils waypoints show on Xaero's Minimap and World Map.
- **Config profiles** with per-server auto-switching.
- **Unfair Features** switch in Management: turns every feature that gives an edge off at once (Free Camera, Freelook, Clear Lava, cave view, Entity Radar, Fast Place, Fast Use, Safe Walk, Place Below, Auto Tool, Auto Flight Gear, Mass Drop's Unfair mode), keeping each one's own setting.
- **Inventory Search**: find items in containers, including inside shulker boxes.
- **Keystrokes**: movement keys and clicks per second on screen.
- **Look-At Info**: a HUD card about the block or entity in your crosshair.
- **Armor Status**: armor and held item durability on the HUD, with low durability warnings.
- **Scoreboard**: the server's sidebar as a movable HUD element, with a card or vanilla style, a font choice and number options.
- **Tab List**: the player list as a movable HUD element, with ping numbers, sorting, columns and a card or vanilla style.
- **Hide Effects**: hides the vanilla status effect icons on the HUD and beside the inventory.
- **Low Shield** and **Small Totem** in Render.
- HUD Overlay: TPS, Looking At, Dimension, Slime Chunk and Day/Night lines, plus Text Shadow and Hide in Containers.
- Beacon Radius Outline draws each cage on Xaero's Minimap, with a Xaero Map Integration setting.
- Copy Coordinates key, Anti Durability thresholds and Hide Thunder Flash.

...

releases.notes:
EMUtils now ships one jar per Minecraft version. This release supports **26.2** and **26.3**; 26.1.x is no longer supported.

## Added

- Minecraft 26.3 support.
- Speed line in the HUD Overlay: shows your speed in blocks per second, including while riding, flying with an elytra or falling. Off by default.
- No Falling Leaf Particles in Visual Tweaks: hides the leaves drifting down from trees, including cherry, pale oak and the new 26.3 poplar leaves. Off by default.
- Mod Menu integration: open the EMUtils settings from Mod Menu's config button.
- `/emutils` command: open settings, toggle features by name, reset a feature to its defaults, and export or import your config through the clipboard.

## Fixed

- Light Level Overlay numbers now show with Iris shader packs.
- Light Level Overlay no longer lags from constantly rescanning chunks.
- Zoom's Hide Hand option now hides your hand again.
- The HUD Overlay panel widens to fit long values such as the Old Growth Spruce Taiga biome instead of spilling past its edge.

## Improved

- Ctrl+Backspace deletes whole words in the settings hub search, and Ctrl+Delete deletes the next word in the script editor.
- EMHelpers is now built into EMUtils, so it's no longer a separate dependency.

releases.notes:
## Added

- Added a No Pumpkin Overlay toggle to hide the carved pumpkin blur while wearing one.
- Added a regular HUD mode for Free Camera, optionally showing the real player's hand, hotbar, health, armor, food, and XP.

## Improved

- EMUtils now targets the two latest Minecraft 26.x releases (26.1.2 and 26.2). Minecraft 1.21.x and older 26.x releases are no longer maintained.
- Legit Quick Stack now adds a short, varied delay between stacks instead of transferring instantly.

## Fixed

- Fixed copied chat messages retaining legacy section formatting codes.
